blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The defense panel in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial has withdrawn their subpoena request for law professor Dean Ralph Sarmiento. In a manifestation submitted to the impeachment court on Thursday, November 5, the defense panel requested that the court either cancel or recall the subpoena for Sarmiento. “Respondent-Accused, by counsel, respectfully manifests that out of respect for Dean Ralph Sarmiento’s decision, the Defense will no longer present him as a witness,” the defense wrote. It added: “A subpoena for him is therefore no longer needed, and if one has already been issued, it is respectfully requested that […]...
